mane.definition:
n. long coarse hair growing from the crest of the animal's neck
n. growth of hair covering the scalp of a human being

maneater.translation: n. 吃人的动物, 食人兽（常用于比喻中）

maneaters.translation: (maneater 的复数) n. 吃人的动物, 食人兽（常用于比喻中）

maneb.translation: [药]代森锰(一种防治叶面病害的保护性杀菌剂)

maned.definition:
v take charge of a certain job; occupy a certain work place
v provide with workers

manege.definition:
n. Art of horsemanship, or of training horses.
n. A school for teaching horsemanship, and for training
   horses.
manege.translation: n. 驯马术, 马术练习场

manent.translation: vi. 留在台上（舞台用语）

manequin.definition: n. An artist's model of wood or other material.

maners.translation: (maner 的复数) n. 马纳（姓氏）

manes.definition: n. a Persian prophet who founded Manichaeism (216-276)

manet.definition: n. French painter whose work influenced the impressionists (1832-1883)
manet.translation: vi.(他或她)留在台上(用作舞台指示语)

maneuver.definition:
n. a military training exercise
n. a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
n. a move made to gain a tactical end
maneuver.translation:
n. 演习, 调遣, 策略
v. 调遣, 演习, 用计

maneuverability.definition: n. the quality of being maneuverable
maneuverability.translation:
n. 操纵灵活性, 机动性
[化] 机动性

maneuverable.definition: s. capable of maneuvering or changing position
maneuverable.translation: a. 操作灵活的, 有机动性的

maneuvered.translation: v. 移动, 用策略( maneuver的过去式和过去分词 ); 操纵

maneuverer.translation: n. 机动；演习；策略；调遣 (maneuver的变形)

maneuvering.definition:
v direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
v act in order to achieve a certain goal
v perform a movement in military or naval tactics in order to secure an advantage in attack or defense
maneuvering.translation: v. 移动, 用策略( maneuver的现在分词 ); 操纵

maneuvers.definition:
n a military training exercise
n a plan for attaining a particular goal
n a deliberate coordinated movement requiring dexterity and skill
n a move made to gain a tactical end
n an action aimed at evading an opponent
v direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
v act in order to achieve a certain goal
v perform a movement in military or naval tactics in order to secure an advantage in attack or defense
maneuvers.translation: n. 策略, 谋略, 花招( maneuver的名词复数 )
